## Summary

Engineer, instructor and junior faculty member at the School of Engineering, KMITL (appointed Engineer, Academic Support Division, Office of the Dean), teaching three Automation Engineering courses in Semester 2/2026, with research experience in neutrino-telescope instrumentation (IceCube-Gen2 optical-module testing at WIPAC), trigger and signal-processing methods for detectors with intermittent channel availability, scientific computing and open research software. B.Eng. in Mechatronics and Automation Engineering, KMITL (2026).

## Research expertise

Detector testing and validation · trigger and data-acquisition methods · measurement algorithms and signal processing · measurement, control and automation systems · scientific software. See [Technical expertise](../about/index.qmd#expertise) for where each was applied.
